notes: LTP and Quote both subscribe 1501 (MODE_TO_XTS_CODE), the market data login carries no source, broadcastMode is Full; the adapter reads camelCase keys, segment names, Touchline for every code and books from Bids/Asks or BidInfo/AskInfo; an unsubscribe disconnects the whole adapter.
Depth 20 on NSE and NFO, as the web's registry lists it (XtsBroker::feed_depth_levels, audit FB-06): both depths subscribe the same 1502 code, and the frames carry the levels its events bring.
The web streams no order updates for this broker (no order adapter, no polling); the desktop has none either (order_feed: false).
